# Missing implicit stores report the aggregate discovery result outside Git.
mkdir non-git
cd non-git
! exec card list
! stdout .
stderr 'no Cardamom store found from'
cd ..

# A Git common directory without .cardamom has the same discovery result.
mkdir repo
exec git -C repo init -b main
cd repo
! exec card list
! stdout .
stderr 'no Cardamom store found from'
